_comment: Per-benchmark-group regression thresholds for the QH-3 perf gate, as a fractional slowdown (0.10 = +10% allowed before REGRESSION). Matched by the group prefix of a criterion id (the part before '/'). Start generous — a shared hosted macOS runner swings widely — and tighten a value only with three clean same-runner runs of evidence. Never drop below ~0.03: layout/frequency noise guarantees false positives under it.

default.rationale: Starting bar for any unlisted bench. 10% is above hosted-runner wall-clock noise; the INCONCLUSIVE band catches the rest.

sync_wave_reconcile.rationale: Reconcile fan-out is O(repos); a real complexity regression clears 10% at the high-scale size.

pipeline_scan.rationale: Per-save nav scan; 10% keeps sub-debounce constant-factor jitter out while catching at-scale walk/parse regressions.

pty_spawn_setup.rationale: Setup-cost only (fork/exec excluded). The timed region includes the ZDOTDIR RC-wrapper fs writes, whose syscall jitter dominates a small assembly — hence a wider band than the pure-CPU paths.

sessions_read.rationale: Cached 50-session projection read at 5,000 inbox messages; fail confident regressions above 10% using the same-runner baseline.
